chapter: Willie Lynch, the Blue Rhythm Band and Teddy Hill
title: Wages and what leaders earned
summary: Sidemen made fifty dollars a week and up, while leaders' earnings depended on what the band took in.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Do you remember what you made?
No, I don't remember. But I mean, it was over the line as far as what Chick was getting. They had a...
What roughly were the wages in those days?
Well, from fifty dollars a week up. Which wasn't bad. Not good, but it wasn't bad. And Willie was making more...Willie's band was making more than that.
Did they have double for leader and all that sort of thing then, or not?

Oh yeah, the leader could get as much as... You know, he might make a million dollars. You know, that's the advantage the leader has. There was no certain amount. It was whatever it would bring. That's why you have rich leaders.
